t: Bosch multi-tool blade set, ideal for general wood and metal applications, including plunge cuts. The larger ACZ 85 EC blade is designed for segment and flooring work, allowing mouldings to be cut to length. The AIZ 20 AB blade can cut plasterboard, copper pipes and wooden planks with embedded nails, while the AIZ 24 EC is suitable for precise plunge cuts in wooden components. Features Starlock mount for maximum power transfer and fast blade changes. Compatible with all common multi-tools.
